instructions: Attempt any three questions out of remaining five questions.
Figures to right indicate full marks.

questions.label: 1a
questions.text: What is the role of a combiner in the map reduce framework? Explain with the help of an example.

questions.text: Why recall is 100% for blooms filter, explain in detail.
